title: Theo and the Winter
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Hazel Yarrow, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
